leads.posting: About the work from home job/internship Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include: 1. Building and updating product pages, collection pages, and landing pages for new drops on our Shopify store (easteamny.com) 2. Making small layout and styling changes to theme sections and templates using the Shopify theme editor, HTML, and CSS 3. Keeping the mobile experience as polished as desktop, since most of our shoppers are on mobile 4. Testing links, pop-ups, forms, and checkout before every launch 5. Looking after site speed, images, and basic SEO (page titles, alt text, clean URLs) 6. Keeping a simple log of what changed on the site and why 7. Bringing ideas to our biweekly website meeting, backed by what you see in the numbers Skill(s) required CSS English Proficiency (Spoken) English Proficiency (Written) Figma Google Analytics HTML JavaScript Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Shopify Earn certifications in these skills Learn CSS Learn Business Communication Learn Figma Learn Google Analytics Learn HTML Learn Node.JS using Javascript Learn Software Testing using Javascript Learn SEO + 1 more skills Who can apply Only those candidates can apply who: 1. are available for the work from home job/internship 2. can start the work from home job/internship between 3rd Oct'26 and 7th Nov'26 3. are available for duration of 3 months 4. have relevant skills and interests * Women wanting to start/restart their career can also apply. Other requirements 1. Real hands-on experience with Shopify, or a similar platform like Wix, Squarespace or WordPress 2. Can read and confidently edit HTML and CSS 3. Strong eye for detail (a misaligned button bothers you) and care for how things look and feel to use 4. Clear, responsive communication in English, written and spoken 5. Works through a task list independently and flags issues early 6. Must have reliable internet and their own computer, and be available for daily overlap with our team's working hours 7. leads.posting: Ge Healthcare is hiring for the role of Graduate Engineer Trainee! Responsibilities of the Candidate: Provide leadership and day-to-day support to production teams to help achieve manufacturing objectives. Monitor production performance and support improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and on-time delivery. Help ensure customer commitments are met in a timely, quality-focused, and cost-conscious manner. Develop and implement training plans to strengthen workforce capability and support employee development. Support Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across production operations. Promote a culture of quality, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement. Support Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), quality, and compliance initiatives in alignment with plant goals. Follow the GE HealthCare Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable regulatory and legal requirements. Complete required Quality and Compliance training within established timelines. Identify and report quality or compliance concerns and support appropriate corrective actions. Maintain compliance with applicable Quality System Regulation and Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements. Understand production process Work Instructions and ensure operations are performed in accordance with defined requirements so products conform to specifications. Ensure production documentation, records, and Device History Records (DHRs) are accurate, complete, and completed on time. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Production Engineering. Demonstrated ability to lead, support, and develop teams in a production or manufacturing environment. Ability to identify and implement best practices and continuous improvement opportunities. Ability to work effectively in an environment with changing priorities and ambiguity. Ability to understand and follow established manufacturing procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and compliance expectations.

leads.posting: About Fam (previously FamPay) Fam is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors. About the Role We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good. As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam.
